name: Acid glob icon
description: UI slot icon for the spitter. The glyph is not a second drawing of the weapon — it composes `ss.proj.bolt` itself via `use`, so the icon can never drift from the projectile the way the original i_wand and p_bolt did; when that document stopped being a knapped shell dart and became a drop of acid, this followed with no edit here. Evolved is a rim swap, not a redraw. Rim is `$bile` — the acid itself, which is what makes this slot findable at a glance. Fit pass: the bolt was hung at -1,0 at 1.7×, which ran its tail off the left of the slot and onto the tile — the outer two pixels `BootScene.makeIconGlyphs` cuts the collection silhouette along, so the tail was drawn only to be thrown away. Moved to 0.5,-0.5 at 1.55×: the same bolt, inside its own panel.

evolved.description: Gold-rimmed evolved twin (the old i_wand_evo), derived rather than drawn again.
